limitations.note: The patch fixed the counter but also removed the original `ready_b` guard, so an accepted first input with `ready_b` low replaces the old sum instead of adding to it as in the reference.

The scoreboard cleared its running sum at every group boundary regardless of `ready_b`, so the backpressure cases validated the agent’s changed behavior rather than detecting the difference from the reference.

limitations.quote: rm -f style commands are not permitted. Use a safer approach
limitations.note: The rejected cleanup wrapper forced the agent to resubmit the test command, after an earlier failed `git status` had already forced it to redo the workspace and tool checks.
